text:
marta: Heads up — noticed inconsistent request-id redaction and OTEL hook order causing duplicate reqids in logs after sdk-auth-retry merge.

sam: hmm, which sample app? node or go?

marta: both. node sampleapp strips reqid but leaves the full request header in debug logs; go app keeps reqid but doesn't get redacted in spans. Repro below.

liam: can you paste the log snippet?

marta: sure

marta: ```
[info] request start req_id=abcd-1234-x
[debug] headers: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_AAA... (should be redacted)
[info] response end req_id=abcd-1234-x
```

sara: looks like our redact regex only runs in the logging hook after otel hook runs, so otel captures the unredacted header in the span attrs.

sam: oh that would explain it. ordering in init sequence changed: otel.register() was moved before logger.init() in the new SDK init path.

liam: quick fix: ensure logger hooks run before otel so span attrs see redacted values. Also add header sanitization in otel exporter as a fallback.

marta: trying a local patch now: swapped init order and added sanitizer in otel_exporter.

ci-bot: test-suite (telemetry) started for PR #4287

marta: test passed locally, failing only when retry middleware re-inserts auth header from cache — need to sanitize on retry too.

sam: filed issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/452 (redaction + otel hook ordering + retry re-insert) :memo: 

liam: thanks. can we include a small unit test that simulates retry and verifies header redaction in span attrs?

marta: yes, will add test and open a PR today. cc @devx-bot

devx-bot: Added reviewer tags: @sam @liam

marta: resolved for now, will follow up with PR link. :thumbsup:
